fields.name: patentId
fields.description: Nexscope internal patent ID. Only a single value is supported; multiple values separated by commas are not allowed. Max length 60000 characters

fields.name: patentNumber
fields.description: Publication/announcement number. Only a single value is supported; multiple values separated by commas are not allowed. Max length 60000 characters

fields.name: replaceByRelated
fields.description: Whether to substitute with a family patent's claims when the current patent's claims are unavailable: 1 yes, 0 no. Max length 1000 characters
